description: Réseau des halles METRO FRANCE is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Les halles METRO. Ce dataset recense l’ensemble des halles METRO en France, avec leurs informations de localisation, de contact et d’horaires d’ouverture. Il est destiné à des usages de: cartographie et géolocalisation, analyse territoriale et commerciale, enrichissement de bases de données, systèmes RAG et applications IA, projets open data. Coverage: Les halles METRO. The publisher named on the listing is Les halles METRO. Its keywords include magasins, contact, halles, adresse-postale, geospatial. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2026-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
